comparison: Per output row r: |got_r - expected_r| <= rtol |expected_r| + atol (Euclidean norms); a non-finite expected component must be matched exactly (NaN by NaN, inf by inf of the same sign). Each case's tolerance is MARGIN times numpy's own measured error against 50-digit mpmath, floored at rtol 1e-12 and atol 1e-12 times the case's largest field.
encoding: floats as JSON numbers, exact on round trip; 'nan', 'inf', '-inf' as strings

kernels.charge_field: X (M, 3), V (N, 3, 3) triangles, c (N, 3) coefficients of 1, u, v -> (M, 3): 4 pi times the field of all triangles, summed (_triangle.charge_field; frames computed from V)
kernels.far_points: V, c -> (6 N, 4): point and charge, row n * 6 + g (_triangle.far_points)
kernels.charge_field_far: X (M, 3), y (6, N, 3), charge (6, N) -> (M, 3), summed
kernels.cuboid_B: X, dimension, polarization, each (M, 3), one cuboid per row in its own frame -> B (M, 3) in T (magpylib _BHJM_magnet_cuboid)
kernels.sheet_H: X (M, 3), V, c, center (3,), far_from (1,) -> H (M, 3) in A/m: charge_field below far_from from center, charge_field_far (from far_points) at or beyond, divided by 4 pi (ChargeSheet._field)
